description:
- Develop enterprise apps that connect and interface with backend systems
 - Interface with client product and project managers 
 - Help create requirements documents and participate in project planning
 - Keep up to date on latest mobile and wearable app technology
 - Willing to learn new tools and technologies as needed
 

 


 - mobile first developer mindset. You are really immersed and engaged in the mobile industry and follow latest developments in mobile platforms, vendors, and technologies. 

 - 1 year experience with development mobile apps that interface with backend data systems
 - Deep understanding of Java, OOP, .NET/C# (for Windows, and Objective-C (for iOS)
 - Experience with network protocols like HTTP, raw sockets, etc.
 - Experience with JSON-RPC, JSON-WSP, Web Services Description Language (WSDL), REST, RPC, or XML.
 - Bachelors Degree in Computer Science a strong plus
 - Big plus: experience with cross-platform tools like Appcelerator, Xamarin, and PhoneGap

 Please email word copy of resume to hourly and salary rate expectations, 
 Ensure it has your contact information, and phone number to reach you.
